Posey Sailing Tactics Simulator 2002 Demo — native JavaScript browser port

Run: node serve.mjs
Open: http://127.0.0.1:8765

Or upload this folder to any static HTTPS host. No build system, Wine,
Windows executable or instruction emulator is needed to play.

Press Space to continue through the original start screens. Use the
original menus or press ? for controls. Sound can be enabled in the footer.
The original demo notices and limits are preserved.

Native execution comparisons and recovered source are retained in the
full preservation workspace; this export contains only the player.
